name: Allgäuer Hof
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Camping site Allgäuer Hof in Tirol is a peaceful spot for nature lovers. The stalls are suitable for RVs, caravans, and tents. Modern sanitary facilities are available for guests. Hiking trails into the surrounding mountains are accessible right from the site. Nearby, there are shopping options and eateries. The site serves as a great starting point for exploring the region.
